title: Active path 4: read suppression in the Jev gate returns a structured "already read" reply for unchanged repeated reads and identical searches, bounded and reversible (v2)
spec:
Today (T-0809) read_economy classifies Read/Grep/Glob calls in the Jev gate and logs would_suppress without acting. Build the active branch behind a new [jev] read_suppression = "off" | "shadow" | "active" key (default shadow; add to promotion.FEATURES as read_suppression with an evidence loader over gate.jsonl). Facts: the gate is a PreToolUse hook (.claude/hooks/jev-gate.sh → jev_gate.run) that can deny a call with a message; guardrails.sh remains the only destructive-command blocker; block_repeats stays as is.
Do:
1. Active: for kind repeated_read_unchanged (same path, mtime and size unchanged) and repeated_search (identical pattern+path+flags), deny the call with a structured reply: "already read at call N in this session; file unchanged (mtime, size); use your earlier result or pass a different range". A narrower_search or a read with a different offset/limit is never suppressed. At most [jev] max_suppressions_per_session (default 20) and never twice in a row for the same path (the second identical attempt is allowed and logged "suppression_override"), so a worker can always recover.
2. Every suppression records an action_gate decision row with selected "suppress" and the tokens_estimate; read_economy.summary adds suppressed, overrides, and the false-suppression proxy computed from overrides + later edits of the path.
3. Safety: refuse active (fall back to shadow with one notify line) when read_economy.summary over the last 7 days shows a false-suppression proxy above [jev] max_false_suppression (default 0.02) or fewer than 50 would_suppress rows.
Tests: tests/test_jev_gate.py::test_active_suppresses_unchanged_repeated_read_with_structured_reply, ::test_active_allows_second_identical_attempt_and_logs_override, ::test_active_never_suppresses_narrower_search_or_different_range, ::test_active_refused_without_evidence; tests/test_read_economy.py::test_summary_counts_suppressions_and_overrides; docs/context-economy/09-read-economy.md Active section with the revert path.
Do not ask questions; decide and note decisions in the result.

SPEC v2 (2026-09-22 22:45) after spec review T-0852 (request_changes), binding on top of v1:
- read_economy.classify() compares the full Read input signature (path, offset, limit and any other range keys; ignoring only cosmetic keys) plus mtime and size: a different offset/limit on an unchanged file is kind "same_file_different_range" and never suppressed. Test: tests/test_read_economy.py::test_different_range_is_never_repeated_read_unchanged.
- Active suppression fires independent of [jev] gate_mode: the read_suppression key alone decides (off/shadow/active), and the deny happens before the Jev sample logic. Test: tests/test_jev_gate.py::test_active_suppresses_with_gate_mode_sample (gate_mode "sample", read_suppression "active" → suppressed).
- Call index: _record_call stores an incrementing per-session call_index on every history entry; the deny message cites the earlier entry's index ("already read at call 7"). Test asserts the cited index equals the earlier matching entry's index.
- read_economy.summary(root, since_s=None) gains a since filter and a top-level "total" block (would_suppress, suppressed, overrides, false_suppression_proxy over unique rows) separate from by_role/by_task_class; the active-mode safety check and the promotion evidence loader read total with since_s=7 days. Test: tests/test_read_economy.py::test_summary_total_block_respects_since_and_counts_rows_once.
acceptance: pool.toml has [jev] read_suppression and promotion.FEATURES has read_suppression; docs/context-economy/09-read-economy.md has an Active section; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0

spec_review_risks.issue: false_suppression_proxy is aggregated today as a raw per-row count (existing test asserts ==1), but the item-3 safety check needs to compare it against a fractional threshold (max_false_suppression default 0.02) in the new total block. The spec reuses one field name for two different semantics (count vs rate) without saying how the total block derives the ratio.

decision_log.record's selected value is hardcoded to "allow" inside finish(). The spec requires selected="suppress" on every suppression's action_gate row, but nothing in the spec says whether the deny path must still route through finish() (which would need a new parameter) or log separately.

Each PreToolUse call is a fresh short-lived process (jev-gate.sh execs a new python process per call; no daemon, no cross-call cache). A literal read of item-3's safety check implies calling read_economy.summary() -- which parses the full gate.jsonl plus every tasks/*.json -- on every Read/Grep/Glob call once read_suppression="active", inside the existing 3s hook timeout.
No acceptance test drives 20+ suppressions in one session, so [jev].max_suppressions_per_session is unverifiable by the merge gate and could ship missing or off-by-one.

"never twice in a row for the same path" is ambiguous: does a third identical attempt after an override get suppressed again, or is suppression permanently disabled for that call once overridden? Only attempts 1 and 2 are covered by the named acceptance test.

_record_call already computes the per-session call_index the deny message must cite, but the history entry built by _call_record and stored via _history() is a separate dict with no call_index field wired in yet -- needs explicit merging before storage.
